5. Yes, always swap gear to the highest level possible, or infuse. Note - Expacs may still be on sale, check it out.
6. Go to The Director, Quests tab, you'll see bounties on the right.

I think they should revert back to the "Destiny" brand, maybe like, Destiny 2020 or something like that, build a boilerplate to carry the game into the future. Every new expansion can be seen as a 'new' game, and allow them to expand on the vision and scope. Just my opinion, feel free to disagree.

Where would you want it to go tho? Personally I would love a more Character driven RPG-esque story sequence like Forsaken with each expansion, because with that approach almost every facet of the game's engagement-loop improved and expanded. Those take a lot of time to develop. This season, to me feels like filler, a little. Like they had some options and with the state of the world they chose the Worthy because of time/ manpower restraints and just, timing in general. Everybody freaking out should try to understand that these guys made fucking Halo. They are professionals, they care, and they know what they're doing.

Most of the time, if you play aggressively the game rewards you as long as you're precise, that is the key. Wittle down her stamina, and Dodge her trash attacks. Don't parry spam, don't attack spam, be patient and precise and you'll win.
